scenarios.title: Listeria RTE verified-evidence recall + replacement allocation
scenarios.description: A ready-to-eat product lot is under a verified-evidence recall and must be isolated (hard safety constraint); compliant replacement supply is allocated to restore access. This is a SIMULATED verified-evidence scenario used to demonstrate the recall-response path; it is NOT driven by a live official recall record and is NOT presented as a live regulatory alert. Real regulatory recalls are integrated separately (openFDA food enforcement); the USDA FSIS meat/poultry recall feed is blocked (HTTP 403) in this environment.
